defects.rationale: The async client.post coroutine is never awaited, so response is a coroutine and accessing .status_code raises AttributeError (and the request may never be sent).

issues.observation: The HTTP POST call has no timeout argument; a hung server would block the coroutine indefinitely. This is a distinct, visible defect in the snippet that the review omits.

revision_instructions: Add a second finding with category `missing_timeout` at line 2, severity medium, with a rationale stating the client.post call specifies no timeout so an unresponsive server causes the notify call to hang indefinitely.
Keep the existing missing_await finding at line 2 exactly as written.
